About this space
Enjoy a cosy experience at this centrally-located 2 bedroomed townhouse in a secure gated community. Stylishly furnished and ideal for business visitors or small families

The space
A cozy 2 bedroomed semidetached townhouse unit in a gated community that boasts of a dining room, lounge and full kitchen. The bathroom has a tub and shower 🚿

Guest access
You can enjoy access to use the back yard space and should you require outdoor BBQ grill, a portable one is available upon request.
